landing.headline: Encrypted mail bound to your name, not this server.
landing.subhead: Pick an OE id, sign up with a passkey, pay once for registry + storage, then this node opts you in. No password.
landing.createMailboxDesc: Sign up with a passkey — your device holds the keys.
landing.orUsePasskey: or use a passkey you already created here
landing.featureOnChain: On-chain name you own — portable across nodes
landing.featurePasskey: Passkey + PRF — no password, keys stay on device
landing.featureSealed: Sealed blobs — node stores ciphertext, you decrypt locally
landing.featureOptIn: Opt-in per node — you choose which provider receives mail
landing.signInDesc: Use a passkey already on this device (including iCloud Keychain).
mail.optInBanner: Opt in to receive mail on this node — confirm with your passkey.
mail.subject: Subject
mail.previewUnsupported: Preview not available for this file type.
trash.confirmDeleteAll: Permanently delete all messages in Trash? This cannot be undone.
compose.subject: Subject
compose.e2ee: Recipient key found — this send will be end-to-end encrypted (OpenPGP).
compose.notE2ee: No OpenPGP key for recipient — this send is not end-to-end encrypted.
settings.title: Settings
settings.manageDesc: Manage opt-in, storage, and device pairing for {{address}}.
settings.connectServiceDesc: Paste an invite from a new node to add your passkey there and authorize that node.
settings.addDeviceDesc: Show a QR code to pair a new passkey on another device.
pay.activateDesc: One-time payment for on-chain registration and {{testnet}}storage on this node.
pay.priceDesc: Your OE id {{oeId}} is registered on-chain. Mail blobs are encrypted to your DEK; this node only stores ciphertext and your opt-in choice.
pay.payHint: Pay in the new tab, or use Mark paid (test only) to skip checkout. This modal updates when payment is confirmed.
recovery.title: Save your recovery secret
recovery.desc: Lose every device and this secret → the mailbox is gone. Store it offline before continuing.
recovery.savedOptIn: I saved it — opt in to this node
pair.addDeviceDesc: Scan this QR on the new device (Add device to another account).
pair.dekSent: DEK sent. Finish on the other device.
pair.addThisDeviceDesc: Scan the QR from Settings on your signed-in device, or paste the session id.
pair.waitingOther: Waiting for the other device to approve. Then create or connect a passkey on this device.
servicePair.openExistingDesc: Pair from another open-email service. Copy the invite to your old node, then paste the grant here.
servicePair.inviteInstructions: On your other service: Settings → Connect to another open-email service. Paste this invite.
servicePair.pasteGrant: Paste grant from your other service
connectService.title: Connect to another open-email service
connectService.desc: Paste the invite from {{address}}'s new node. You will get a grant to paste back there.
connectService.pasteInvite: Paste invite from the other service
connectService.authorizing: You are authorizing {{domain}} to receive mail for {{name}}.
connectService.confirmDomain: Confirm this is the domain shown on the registry.
connectService.copyGrant: Copy this grant back to the other service.
